contents.text: By what percentage did Netflix's technology and development expenses change in 2025 compared to 2024?

The increase in technology and development expenses for the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024 was primarily due to a $438 million increase in personnel-related costs. (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)
